from scipy.special import erfc

def problem(x: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """
    A synthetic benchmark function designed to test global optimization algorithms.
    """
    dim = x.shape[0]

    # Skewed quadratic surface
    Q = np.array([[1.0, 0.2], [0.2, 0.5]]) if dim == 2 else np.eye(dim)
    skewed_quadratic = 0.5 * x @ Q @ x * 0.8

    # Rotated Gaussian
    if dim >= 2:
        rotation_matrix = np.array([[0.707, -0.707], [0.707, 0.707]])
        x_rotated = x[:2] @ rotation_matrix
        gaussian_peak = -0.6 * np.exp(-0.5 * np.sum((x_rotated - [1, -1])**2))
    else:
        gaussian_peak = -0.6 * np.exp(-0.5 * (x[0] - 1)**2) if dim > 0 else -0.6 * np.exp(-0.5)

    # Sine-modulated cubic
    cubic_term = 0.1 * x[0]**3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * x[0]) if dim >= 1 else 0.0

    # Inverse quadratic modulated by x[1]
    inverse_quadratic = -0.2 / (1 + (x[0]**2 / (1 + x[1]**2))) if dim >= 2 else -0.2 / (1 + x[0]**2) if dim > 0 else -0.2

    # Complementary error function
    erfc_term = 0.3 * erfc(x[0]) if dim >= 1 else 0.3 * erfc(0)

    # Rational term modulated with x[1]
    rational_term = 0.1 * (x[1] / (1 + x[0]**2)) if dim >= 2 else 0.0

    return skewed_quadratic + gaussian_peak + cubic_term + inverse_quadratic + erfc_term + rational_term
